mapper.select: SELECT task_status status, COUNT(*) count FROM t_ai_task WHERE record_type='INDEX_OUTBOX' GROUP BY task_status
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_task SET task_status='RETRY_PENDING',retry_count=0,next_retry_at=NOW(3), lease_holder=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,lease_generation=lease_generation+1, error_detail=CONCAT('MANUAL_REPLAY: ',#{reason}),updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND record_type='INDEX_OUTBOX' AND task_status='FAILED'
mapper.select: SELECT task_key FROM t_ai_task WHERE task_key IN #{key}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO t_ai_task(record_type,source_id,task_key,task_status,input_snapshot, snapshot_retention_until,next_retry_at) VALUES ('INDEX_OUTBOX',#{row.sourceId},#{row.taskKey},'PENDING',CAST(#{row.inputSnapshot} AS JSON),DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL 30 DAY),NOW(3))
mapper.select: SELECT id,input_snapshot,retry_count, lease_generation FROM t_ai_task WHERE record_type='INDEX_OUTBOX' AND task_status IN ('PENDING','RETRY_PENDING','PROCESSING') AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at<=NOW(3)) AND (task_status<>'PROCESSING' OR lease_expires_at<NOW(3)) ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_task SET task_status='PROCESSING',lease_holder=#{holder}, lease_generation=lease_generation+1, lease_expires_at=DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL 2 MINUTE),updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND record_type='INDEX_OUTBOX' AND task_status IN ('PENDING','RETRY_PENDING','PROCESSING')
mapper.select: SELECT id,input_snapshot,retry_count, lease_holder,lease_generation FROM t_ai_task WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_holder=#{holder} AND task_status='PROCESSING'
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_task SET task_status=#{status},retry_count=#{retry}, next_retry_at=IF(#{terminal},NOW(3),DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL #{delay} SECOND)),lease_holder=NULL, lease_expires_at=NULL,error_detail=#{error},updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND task_status='PROCESSING' AND lease_holder=#{holder} AND lease_generation=#{generation}
